The pie chart represents a survey with the question: 'In which layer is design well integrated into the process on our product development:'

 Colored sectors: green (#32CD32), red (#FF4136), blue (#0073A9), light blue (#ADD8E6), orange (#FF5722)
 The green sector represents the most common response with 25, followed by the light blue sector with 20. The red sector represents the second most common response with 8, and the blue sector represents the third most common response with 10. The orange sector represents the least common response. There are no legends, percentages, or any visual emphasis (such as enlargement or highlighting) on any of the sectors. The sectors are arranged from the largest to the smallest capacity, starting with the green sector and moving clockwise.
